author: Kushal
problem: A research station's crew_size guards, numbered 1 to crew_size, take the night watch in turn, going back to guard 1 after the last. first_guard has tonight's watch. Return the list of guards on watch for the next nights nights, starting with tonight.
bug_description: Uses (first_guard + n) % crew_size instead of (first_guard + n - 1) % crew_size + 1, so the last guard comes out as 0 whenever it is their turn.

comments.accurate: Lists who has the watch on each coming night, cycling through guards 1 to crew_size
comments.wrong_behavior: Lists each night's guard as the first guard plus the night offset, wrapped by the crew size
comments.wrong_location: Rotation formula checked; the loop may stop one night short of the requested count
